subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la touch sense yen reliable illa, temperature meaning, thermometer types, correct thermometer use, Celsius/Fahrenheit/Kelvin scales matrum melting/boiling observations-ai kathukkolvom. Thermometer use pannumbodhu safety mukkiyam.
learning_objectives: Touch mattum vechu hot/cold decide panna yen podhaadhu-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Clinical matrum laboratory thermometers-ai distinguish panna mudiyum.
Thermometer reading-ai correct-aa edukkavum read pannavum mudiyum.
Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin scales-ai identify panna mudiyum.
Melting/boiling process-la temperature observations-ai explain panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Touch sense mattum podhaadhu
teaching_sequence.caption: Rendu water bowls different temperature-la irundhaalum hand touch misleading-aa irukkalaam. Same water-ai different temperature-la irundha hands different-aa feel pannum. Hotness/coldness-ai reliable-aa compare panna thermometer thevai.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Oru kai cool water-la, innoru kai warm water-la konjam neram vechu, appuram rendu kaiyum room-temperature water-la vainga. Same water different-aa feel aagalaam. Teacher supervision follow pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Touch sense yen always reliable illa? Temperature measure panna enna instrument use pannuvom?

teaching_sequence.title: Temperature-na enna?
teaching_sequence.caption: Temperature oru body evvalavu hot alladhu cold-nu measure pannura quantity. Hotter body generally higher temperature kaattum. Touch sensation vida thermometer numerical reading kudukkum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ice water-um warm water-um compare pannumbodhu, thermometer reading hotness-ai number-la kaattum. Temperature reading-ai unit-oda record pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Temperature enna measure pannudhu? Thermometer reading yen touch vida reliable?

teaching_sequence.title: Clinical thermometer safety
teaching_sequence.caption: Clinical thermometer body temperature measure panna design pannappattadhu. Digital thermometer use pannumbodhu instructions follow pannunga; use-kku munnum pinbum clean pannunga. Shared thermometer-ai hygiene rules-oda handle pannunga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Thermometer tip-ai clean pannunga; display-ai water-la immerse panna koodadhu. Fever check panna device instructions follow pannanum; adult help use pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Clinical thermometer edhai measure pannum? Use-kku munnum pinbum enna care edukkanum?

teaching_sequence.title: Laboratory thermometer
teaching_sequence.caption: Laboratory thermometer experiments-la liquids/objects temperature measure panna use pannuvom. Idhoda range clinical thermometer vida wider-aa irukkalaam. Bulb liquid-kulla irukkumbodhu container bottom/side touch pannaama reading edukkanum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Thermometer bulb-ai liquid-la immerse pannunga; scale-ai eye level-la read pannunga. Reading edukkurappo bulb liquid-kulla irukkanum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Laboratory thermometer edharku use aagum? Reading edukkumbodhu bulb enga irukkanum?

teaching_sequence.title: Thermometer reading correct-aa eduppom
teaching_sequence.caption: Thermometer range-um smallest division-um check pannunga. Scale-ai eye level-la read pannunga; parallax avoid pannunga. Liquid thermometer-la bulb-ai correct position-la vechu, reading stable aagura vara wait pannunga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Different thermometers different ranges/least counts kondirukkum. Scale markings-ai first paarthu, appuram reading edunga. Teacher instructions-ai follow pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Least count-na enna? Thermometer scale-ai eye level-la yen read pannanum?

teaching_sequence.title: Heating, cooling, melting
teaching_sequence.caption: Ice heat aagumbodhu melting nadakkum. Pure substance melt aagura time-la temperature konja neram constant-aa irukkalaam, heat continue panninaalum. Experiments-la hot water/burner use pannumbodhu teacher supervision compulsory.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Ice melt aagura activity-ai observe pannumbodhu temperature reading-ai time-oda note pannunga. Burner, boiling water, hot glassware-ai neenga thaniya handle panna koodadhu.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Melting nadakkumbodhu temperature constant-aa irukka mudiyuma? Hot experiment-la safety yen mukkiyam?

teaching_sequence.title: Temperature scales
teaching_sequence.caption: Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin moonu common temperature scales. Weather reports-la Celsius common; sila places-la Fahrenheit use pannuvanga; science-la Kelvin use pannuvanga. Unit symbol-ai correct-aa write pannunga.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Same temperature different scales-la different number-aa represent aagum. Celsius °C, Fahrenheit °F, Kelvin K. Kelvin symbol-kku degree sign use panna maattom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Temperature-oda moonu scales enna? Kelvin unit-ai eppadi write pannuvom?

teaching_sequence.title: Temperature recap
teaching_sequence.caption: Temperature hotness/coldness-ai quantify pannum; thermometer reading correct-aa edukka range, least count, eye position, safety consider pannanum. Clinical/lab thermometers different purpose-ku use aagum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Lesson-la touch limitations, thermometer types, scales, melting observation ellam connect pannuvom. Oru thermometer reading-ai unit-oda explain pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Clinical-um laboratory thermometer-um eppadi different? Accurate reading-kku rendu precautions sollunga.
